description: CONVERSION OF PROPERTY FROM 2 x SELF-CONTAINED FLATS BACK INTO A SINGLE FAMILY DWELLINGHOUSE
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;">No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority confirming that the residential development has achieved CO2 reductions&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 12pt;">(minimum 35% improvement against Part L 2021 on site)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;and wholesome water consumption rates of no greater than 105 litres per person per day.’&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt">Reason: To ensure that the development achieves a high standard of sustainability and makes efficient use of resources and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: Policy SI2 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CC2.1 – 2.6 of Merton's Local Plan 2024.</span></p>
